newsitem.title: GERMANY: Saltus shares issued at 37 marks.
newsitem.headline: Saltus shares issued at 37 marks.

text.p: Shares in Germany's Saltus Technology will be issued to subscribers to the company's initial public offering at a price of 37 marks, arranger DG Bank said on Friday.
Saltus said on Thursday that its issue of 800,000 shares for the bourse's New Market for growth stocks had been oversubscribed by more than 100 times.
Due to the heavy demand, the close of the subscription period for the shares was brought forward to 1200 GMT on Thursday. Previously, the firm had said the subscription period would end on July 11.

DG Bank said that, due to the high demand, only every 23rd order received had been allocated shares. The orders to be fulfilled were selected in a lottery. More than half of the shares had gone to domestic investors, it said.

Saltus, which is an engineering company, reported a net profit of 2.2 million marks for the business year ended January 31 on sales of 14.7 million marks. The shares will list on the New Market from Monday.
